title: Replace a BÄSTIS lint roller refill with both hands
instruction: Hold the lint roller by its handle. Remove the used roll, fit the fresh refill, and lay the reassembled roller back in its rest.
context: IKEA BÄSTIS 904.256.26 reusable polypropylene handle with 301.411.26 pull-off refill. One hand supports the free handle against insertion and extraction loads. The other grips the rolled paper, withdraws it along the spindle and presses the replacement to its shoulder.
setup: Assembled tool length about 219 mm with a 120 mm gray handle and 99 mm sleeve. Used OD 44 mm, new OD 48 mm, 33 mm bore and tapered 27.3 mm model spindle. Handle starts horizontal in a 349 mm rail rest with an end stop. Fresh roll is parallel on a second rest and the discard tray is on the other side.
scoring: 0.25 for removal with both arms and a released spent refill in the tray. 0.50 when the fresh roll seats with the handle held by the opposite hand, ±4 mm axial, <3.5 mm radial and <7° alignment error. 0.75 when it stays fitted during a further ≥15 mm lift by the handle alone. Full score for the reassembled roller released in its rest for 1 s within 2 mm and 3° of the initial released pose.
reset_notes: Restore the handle and spent roll in the common rest. Set the replacement on the other rest, clear the discard tray and reset trial history.
fidelity: The reference assembly is 22 cm long with a pull-off refill. Bore, roll length, handle profile and retention geometry are estimates from product views. The rests keep the parts from rolling at reset, and the handle is a free rigid body during exchange.
